objects.name: Nessa
objects.text: The east road reaches Saltfen. The north road climbs to the Broken Beacon. I trade supplies here in the square.

objects.name: Mara Gull
objects.text: Welcome to the Lantern and Gull. The island paths are marked on your atlas.

objects.name: Orrin Vale
objects.text: A shield and a patient step will carry you farther than a hurried blade.

objects.name: Elin Reed
objects.text: The town is a sanctuary. Return here to recover your strength.

objects.name: Sera Venn
objects.text: The old beacon cellars descend twice. A lever opens the lower ward; the brass key opens the final vault.

objects.name: Tomas Netter
objects.text: I mend the nets while the tidehounds prowl the western shore.

objects.name: Ada Moss
objects.text: I have lived here all my life. The cemetery road is quiet only by daylight.

objects.name: Brin Pike
objects.text: I saw a salt hexer beyond Saint Orin's wall.

objects.name: Jory Bell
objects.text: Beyond these streets the sanctuary ends. Keep a healing tonic ready.

objects.name: Lena Wren
objects.text: There is a side path west into Morrowwood.

objects.name: Pella Ash
objects.text: Saltfen water is bitter. Stay on the causeway.

objects.name: Ivo Finch
objects.text: Signs and discovery marks are copied into your field journal.

objects.name: Cora Salt
objects.text: The dock is sound, but there are no boats sailing in this demo.

objects.name: Fen Low
objects.text: The supply chests can be opened like your own backpack.

objects.name: Maeve Thorn
objects.text: The Lantern Keeper waits below the beacon. Take the upper cellar key first.

objects.name: Greyhaven Waystone
objects.text: NORTH: Broken Beacon and cellars. WEST: Morrowwood. EAST: Saltfen and Saint Orin. SOUTH: Gullhook docks.

objects.name: Morrowwood Trail
objects.text: Morrowwood: wolves of the tide shelter beneath the trees.

objects.name: Saltfen Causeway
objects.text: Keep to the raised path. Slingers watch the fen.

objects.name: Broken Beacon
objects.text: Beneath the beacon: the Drowned Cellars. Double-click the stair marker to descend.

objects.name: Saint Orin Cemetery
objects.text: Rest for the lost; watch for the living.
